The table lists every atom of one conventional cubic cell of Zn(imidazolate)2 with ZIF-8 sodalite topology (SALEM-2, COD 4118891; major-occupancy linker sites). Use the kinematic structure factor with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (C = 6, H = 1, N = 7, Zn = 30). For radiation of wavelength 1.54060 Å and first-order Bragg diffraction, at what angle 2θ does the lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity appear?

选项：
A. 3.71°
B. 5.25°
C. 7.42°
D. 9.09°
